chunks.heading: Return window
chunks.text: Customers can return an item within 30 days of the delivery date. Items must be unused and in their original packaging. Clearance items marked "final sale" cannot be returned.

chunks.heading: How to start a return
chunks.text: Open the customer dashboard, choose the order, and select "Start a return". A prepaid return label is generated as a PDF. Attach the label to the parcel and drop it at any partner collection point. Return labels expire 10 days after they are generated.

chunks.heading: Refund timing
chunks.text: Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5 business days after the returned parcel is scanned at the warehouse. Card refunds can take a further 3 to 7 business days to appear on a statement, depending on the bank.

chunks.heading: Return shipping fees
chunks.text: Returns are free when the item arrived damaged or the wrong item was sent. For any other reason a return fee of 3 USD is deducted from the refund.

chunks.heading: Damaged or lost parcels
chunks.text: Report a damaged parcel within 7 days of delivery and include two photos: one of the outer packaging and one of the item. A parcel is treated as lost when tracking shows no movement for 10 business days. Lost parcels are refunded in full or re-sent at no charge, whichever the customer prefers.

chunks.heading: Exchanges
chunks.text: Parcelwise does not process direct exchanges. Return the original item for a refund and place a new order for the replacement.

chunks.heading: Shipping Policy
chunks.text: Parcelwise is a fictional courier software company used as sample data for this demo.

chunks.heading: Delivery times
chunks.text: Standard delivery takes 3 to 5 business days within the same country. Express delivery takes 1 to 2 business days and is available for parcels under 20 kg. International delivery takes 7 to 14 business days depending on customs clearance.

chunks.heading: Shipping costs
chunks.text: Standard delivery costs a flat 4.50 USD for parcels up to 5 kg. Each additional kilogram costs 0.80 USD. Express delivery costs 12 USD for parcels up to 5 kg. Orders above 75 USD qualify for free standard delivery.

chunks.heading: Cut-off times
chunks.text: Orders placed before 2:00 PM local warehouse time are dispatched the same business day. Orders placed after the cut-off, or on weekends and public holidays, are dispatched on the next business day.

chunks.heading: Tracking
chunks.text: Every parcel receives a tracking number by email within one hour of dispatch. Tracking updates appear in the customer dashboard and through the Tracking API. If a tracking number shows no movement for 72 hours, contact support so the parcel can be traced with the carrier.

chunks.heading: Restricted items
chunks.text: Parcelwise does not ship lithium batteries above 100 Wh, aerosols, perishable food, or cash. Parcels containing restricted items are returned to the sender at the sender's cost.

chunks.heading: Authentication
chunks.text: All requests need an API key sent in the `X-Api-Key` header. Keys are created in the dashboard under Settings, then Developers. A key can be restricted to read-only access. Rotate keys every 90 days; a rotated key stays valid for 24 hours so integrations can switch over without downtime.

chunks.heading: Rate limits
chunks.text: The API allows 120 requests per minute per key. Requests over the limit receive HTTP 429 with a `Retry-After` header that gives the wait time in seconds. Bulk lookups should use the batch endpoint instead of many single calls.

chunks.heading: Get a parcel status
chunks.text: `GET /v2/parcels/{trackingNumber}` returns the current status, the last scan location, and the estimated delivery date. Status is one of: `created`, `in_transit`, `out_for_delivery`, `delivered`, `exception`, `returned`.

chunks.heading: Batch lookup
chunks.text: `POST /v2/parcels/batch` accepts up to 100 tracking numbers in one request and returns a status object for each. Unknown tracking numbers are returned with status `not_found` and do not fail the whole request.

chunks.heading: Webhooks
chunks.text: Webhooks send a POST request to your endpoint whenever a parcel status changes. Each delivery is signed with an HMAC-SHA256 signature in the `X-Parcelwise-Signature` header. Failed deliveries are retried up to 5 times with exponential backoff, starting at 30 seconds. Your endpoint must answer with a 2xx status within 10 seconds.

chunks.heading: Errors
chunks.text: Errors use standard HTTP status codes with a JSON body containing `code` and `message`. A 401 means the key is missing or invalid. A 403 means the key lacks permission for that endpoint. A 404 means the tracking number does not exist.

chunks.heading: Sandbox
chunks.text: The sandbox base URL is `https://sandbox.parcelwise.example`. Sandbox tracking numbers that start with `TEST` cycle through every status once per minute, which makes webhook testing easier.
